planned_by: Claude (Critic): gap review R41-1/R09-2 — ledger resets on every deploy
goal:
T39 — make the cost ledger durable with the PostgreSQL backend (it resets to 0 on every deploy today).

services/api/evoforge/ledger.py keeps budgets, spend, reservations and overruns in process dicts. When
postgres_state.backend() is configured (EVO_STATE_BACKEND=postgres), write every ledger event (reserve, settle,
refund, mark_unknown, reconcile, overrun) append-only to the existing evidence store
(postgres_state.ScopedRecords("records")) as records with document kind "ledger_event" (reservation_id, project,
event, cents, reason, ts), and rebuild the in-memory state from that journal lazily on first use in a new process
(e.g. a module flag `_loaded`, set False -> the next reserve/settle/snapshot/available call replays the journal).
Replaying must give identical snapshot() results; an open reservation can still be settled after a restart.
Memory mode (no backend) behaves exactly as today, including reset() for tests. Never store secrets or prompts.
Tests: services/api/tests/test_muse_t39.py (memory mode) and live-PG tests using the test_postgres_kernel fixtures
(`database`, `funded`) like tests/test_performance_persistence_pg.py. Do not change main.py endpoints.
